author: Yffe
content: Audit of the four authored oracle fixtures (binary_search.addresses.json, sum.addresses.json, address/README.md, parse/binary_search.facts.json) found NO DIVERGENCE — all faithfully transcribe the verbatim corpus + thermite-design.md §4.1/§4.3/Appendix A + semantic-addressing.md AC-1/AC-2. Gap: the route conformance_ops=[binary_search, sum, recover_per_item] for thermite-syntax/src/parse implies sum.facts.json and recover_per_item.{facts,addresses}.json are expected, but only binary_search.facts.json exists. recover_per_item.th corpus also absent. Per-item recovery (design §4.3 'recovery is per-item by construction') has no oracle fixture yet. Non-blocking; the four present fixtures are clean.
